source_read: https://www.nandos.co.uk/food/menu/index.html rendered in Chromium (one page load, robots.txt checked with tools/uk_extract/robots_rfc.py; images and third parties blocked; the Allergens tab of all 137 product cards opened) plus the data feed the page itself loads, https://www.nandos.co.uk/food/menu/page-data/index/page-data.1791365082461.json (Last-Modified 2026-10-07), downloaded fresh 2026-10-08 (byte-identical to the 5 Oct copy)
notes: Allergens are NOT a separate request: every entry in Nando's menu feed carries an `allergens` list (name + YES / MAYBE_FROM_MANUFACTURING / MAYBE_FROM_KITCHEN_CROSS_CONTAMINATION + message) that the panel's Allergens tab prints. nandos.py copies it (YES -> contains, MAYBE -> may contain, GLUTEN_<cereal> and named nuts -> kinds); unknown allergen words or presence values stop the run, and 4 negative tests (unknown word, unknown presence, contradictory 'May contain' on a YES, half the lists missing) all stop it. All 126 published rows (115 distinct panels) were compared with the rendered panel text by a separate script (contains / may contain / cereals / tree-nut kinds, all labels as displayed); 0 differ, and 3 deliberately injected errors in a control copy were all caught. Also checked: every allergen message shown in the tab is in the item's notes. Held back for allergens (10, listed in holdback.csv): the 6 spice levels (the feed's option lists are empty on every dish and the page shows none), Corn on the Cob (Nandinos side) (own list empty and tagged vegan while the regular corn it borrows from marks milk), Cucumber Sticks (Nandinos side) (no list; already held back for its kcal), PERinaise (Nando's own description: bottles have slightly different ingredients, double check the allergens) and PERi-Plant Fillet (its own message says it may contain celery and mustard, its list does not). The 2 nutrition holdbacks are unchanged. Nando's states the list is for the dish on its own without customisations, spices, sides or extras: said in note.txt. Kept with the chain's message copied into notes: Phantom Wings and Tombstone Chips (malt vinegar from barley processed to remove gluten) and Tiny Rebel Session IPA (contains barley and wheat processed to remove gluten) show no gluten mark exactly as Nando's prints. The feed and the panel share one data source and Nando's publishes no separate allergen PDF, so this checks our copy, not Nando's own accuracy.
